purpose: Pre-registration for the adjacency-stacking probe. Pinned BEFORE the run, because a classification chosen after seeing the result is not a classification.
evidence_level_intended: spike on a stated model - NOT a measurement of the real portfolio
classification_basis: generic_infra = a capability any windowed application needs regardless of what it is for. domain = a capability that exists because of what this particular product does.
only_difference: positions 2 and 3 are swapped. Nothing else differs - same apps, same capability map, same classification.
prediction_registered_before_running: arm A yields a strictly higher shared_candidate count at app 2 than arm B, and the excess is entirely in the domain class.
how_it_could_come_out_badly: if the two arms tie at app 2, or if arm A's excess is in generic_infra rather than domain, the adjacency-stacking mechanism is not demonstrated by this model and the claim must be withdrawn.
